title: 第7章 药池风波
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
食堂的饭菜谈不上多好吃，但胜在量大管饱。

    苏念念端着一盘红烧排骨，外加一碗米饭，坐在安槐对面吃得喷香，她吃东西的时候毫无形象可言，腮帮子鼓得像只松鼠，还不忘用筷子指挥安槐。

    “多吃点，你那盘青菜够谁吃的？”

    “够我吃的。”

    “你淬体五重的人就吃这个？难怪你胳膊跟竹竿似的。”

    安槐把一块排骨夹到她碗里，“那老大帮我多吃一块。”

    苏念念低头看了眼碗里的排骨，嘴角抖了一下，闷头吃掉了。

    周小鱼端着餐盘从后面挤过来，一屁股坐在苏念念旁边，眼睛亮晶晶的。

    “念念念念！药池名额的通知出来了！下午就能去！你看到没？”

    “看到了。”苏念念拿手机翻了翻，“前五名第一批，下午两点，我排第七，要等第二批。”

    “可是安槐第一名呀，他不是可以带人吗？”周小鱼看向安槐。

    安槐点头，“已经申请好了，念念跟我一起第一批。”

    苏念念嚼着排骨，假装没听到，但耳朵尖微微发红。

    周小鱼看看苏念念，又看看安槐，心里疯狂竖大拇指。

    “安槐你对念念也太好了吧。”

    “老大对我更好。”安槐语气平淡，“小时候我发烧，老大把自己的退烧贴全贴我脑门上，她自己额头烫得跟烙铁似的都不管。”

    苏念念猛地抬头，筷子差点戳到鼻子上。

    “你怎么什么都记得？那都是多少年前的事了！”

    “老大的事，每件都记得。”

    苏念念脸上的红从耳朵蔓延到了脸颊，她狠狠夹了一筷子青菜塞进嘴里，含含糊糊地骂了一句。

    “贫嘴。”

    【检测到情绪源“苏念念”释放情绪：害羞（55%）、心跳加速（30%）、想把你脑袋按到饭里（15%）。宿主，你继续撩，我继续收割，咱俩配合得天衣无缝。】

    安槐喝了口汤，没搭理系统。

    下午两点，药池楼。

    这栋楼在校区最深处，独立于教学区和宿舍区之外。

    灰色的建筑外墙上刻满了繁复的引导纹路，那是用来将灵气引入药池的阵法基座，由学校专门聘请的铭文师维护。

    第一批五个名额，加上安槐带的苏念念，一共六人。

    安槐和苏念念到的时候，其他四个人已经在门口等着了。

    排名第二是个瘦高个男生，叫陈峥，二班的，淬体四重，气质阴沉，看人的时候总像在打量猎物。

    排名第三是苏念念的实战评估并列者，一个叫韩青的女生，一班的，世家子弟，面无表情，排名第四和第五分别来自四班和五班，安槐没记名字，看着都是老实孩子。

    负责管理药池的是一个干巴巴的老头，姓吴，脸上皱纹能夹死苍蝇，说话却中气十足。

    “进去之前说规矩。药池每次浸泡时限一个小时，超时不候。池子一共三个，男女分开用，第三个池子备用。浸泡期间不要运功对抗药力，顺其自然，药力会自动渗透经脉，听明白了没？”

    众人点头。

    苏念念凑到安槐耳边小声问：“分开用的话，你不跟我一个池子吧？”

    “……老大，男女分开。”

    “我知道啊，我就是确认一下。”苏念念面不改色，“我可不想泡着泡着旁边冒出来一根电线杆。”

    安槐嘴角弯了一下。

    进了药池楼内部，空气里弥漫着一股浓郁的药香，有点像薄荷混着松木的味道，闻起来提神醒脑。

    三个池子分布在三间独立的房间里，池水呈现半透明的淡蓝色，表面微微冒着热气。

    苏念念和韩青分到了二号池。

    安槐和陈峥、另外两个男生分到了一号池。
content_en:
The food in the cafeteria is not very delicious, but it is good in that it is plentiful and filling.

Su Niannian was carrying a plate of braised pork ribs and a bowl of rice, sitting across from An Huai and eating deliciously. She had no image at all when eating, her cheeks were bulging like a squirrel, and she didn't forget to use chopsticks to order An Huai.

"Eat more. Who can eat your plate of vegetables?"

"Enough for me to eat."

"Is this what you, a fifth-level body tempering person, eat? No wonder your arms are like bamboo poles."

An Huai put a piece of ribs into her bowl, "Then boss, help me eat an extra piece."

Su Niannian lowered her head and glanced at the ribs in the bowl, trembled at the corner of her mouth, and ate it.

Zhou Xiaoyu squeezed over from behind with a dinner plate and sat down next to Su Niannian, his eyes bright.

"Think, think, think! The notification of the quota for the medicine pool is out! You can go there in the afternoon! Did you see it?"

"I saw it." Su Niannian flipped through the phone, "The top five are in the first batch. At two o'clock in the afternoon, I am in seventh place and have to wait for the second batch."

"But An Huai is number one, can't he take someone with him?" Zhou Xiaoyu looked at An Huai.

An Huai nodded, "I have already applied. Niannian will be in the first batch with me."

Su Nian Nian chewed the ribs and pretended not to hear, but the tips of her ears turned slightly red.

Zhou Xiaoyu looked at Su Niannian and then at An Huai, giving a crazy thumbs up in his heart.

"An Huai, you are too kind to Niannian."

"The boss is nicer to me." An Huai said calmly, "When I was a child, I had a fever, and the boss put all her fever-reducing patches on my forehead. She didn't care when her forehead was as hot as a soldering iron."

Su Niannian raised her head suddenly and almost poked her nose with her chopsticks.

"Why do you remember everything? That was all so many years ago!"

"Boss, I remember everything."

The blush on Su Niannian's face spread from her ears to her cheeks. She took a chopstick of vegetables and stuffed it into her mouth, cursing vaguely.

"Poor mouth."

[The emotion source "Su Niannian" was detected to release emotions: shyness (55%), rapid heartbeat (30%), and wanting to push your head into the rice (15%).Host, you continue to flirt, and I continue to harvest. We work together perfectly.】

An Huai took a sip of soup and ignored the system.

Two o'clock in the afternoon, Yaochi Building.

This building is located in the deepest part of the campus, independent of the teaching area and dormitory area.

The outer wall of the gray building is engraved with complicated guidance patterns, which are the base of the formation used to introduce spiritual energy into the medicine pool. They are maintained by the inscription master specially hired by the school.

There are five places in the first batch, plus An Huai's Su Niannian, for a total of six people.

When An Huai and Su Niannian arrived, the other four people were already waiting at the door.

The second ranked boy is a tall and thin boy named Chen Zheng, from Class 2, Level 4 Body Tempering, with a gloomy temperament. He always looks at people as if he is sizing up prey.

Ranked third was Su Niannian's tie-for-combat evaluation, a girl named Han Qing, from Class 1, a child of an aristocratic family, with an expressionless face. Ranked fourth and fifth were from Class 4 and Class 5 respectively. An Huai didn't remember the names, and they looked like they were all honest kids.

The person in charge of managing the medicine pool is a dry old man named Wu. His face has wrinkles that could kill a fly, but his words are full of energy.

"Let me talk about the rules before going in. Each soaking time in the medicine pool is one hour, and you will not wait after the time limit. There are three pools, separated for men and women, and the third pool is reserved. During the soaking period, do not use your power to resist the power of the medicine. Let nature take its course. The medicine will automatically penetrate the meridians. Do you understand?"

Everyone nodded.

Su Niannian leaned into An Huai's ear and whispered, "If we use them separately, why don't you share the same pool with me?"

"...Boss, men and women are separated."

"I know, I just want to confirm." Su Niannian said without changing her expression, "I don't want to be soaked while a telephone pole pops up next to me."

An Huai's mouth curved.

Entering the medicine pool building, the air is filled with a strong medicinal aroma, a bit like mint mixed with pine wood, which smells refreshing.

The three pools are distributed in three separate rooms. The water is translucent light blue and slightly steaming on the surface.

Su Niannian and Han Qing were assigned to the second pool.

An Huai, Chen Zheng, and two other boys were assigned to Pool 1.
title_en: Chapter 7 The Incident in the Medicine Pond
